name: cc-thinking-skills
title_zh: 28 个思维模型，让编程 Agent 先想对再动手
tagline_zh: 装进 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具，每个 Skill 都是一次苏格拉底式拷问：你验证过假设吗？
tagline_en: Drop into Claude Code, Cursor, etc. Each skill is a Socratic check: did you verify assumptions? Where are the.
desc_en: 28 eval-informed mental models and critical-thinking skills for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, and other Agent Skills-compatible tools
why_zh: 不是提示词堆砌，而是把 eval 中暴露的失败模式固化成可复用的检查清单。
why_en: Not prompt fluff—it turns eval failure modes into reusable checklists that make agents interrogate their own plans before.
limit_zh: 只覆盖编程与设计决策的思维层面，不提供具体代码模板或调试工具。
limit_en: Covers thinking/design only—no code templates or debuggers. Requires an Agent Skills-compatible IDE/CLI; 28 skills must be enabled individually, no.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 28 mental models that make coding agents think before acting
